hooks.text: "They buried the legions with their pay chests. The legions aren't spending it."
"Old legion iron is better than anything we can buy. Bring up what's in their chests and we'll make something of it. The daughter."
"A collector in Greyholt pays for anything with the old stamp on it. Don't ask which collector."
"If there's rope down there, it's older than my rope, and I want to know how it held up."
"The dead were buried with things for the road. They have finished with the road."
"One of us dropped a strongbox down a barrow hole last week. Something has since carried it further in."

brief.many: Open {n} chests in the Old Barrows

label: Chests opened in the Old Barrows
journal: Go down into the Old Barrows and open {n} of the chests there.
ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Tired Mule in Thornwick.
done: Whatever was in the boxes is somebody else's problem now.

hooks.text: "There's stock in {site} that was somebody's once and is nobody's now. Bring it out and I'll make it mine, fairly."
"Chests in {site}, unopened since the canal drowned. The Guild would like to know what's in them, and so would you."
"The last lot who went into {site} took our good tankards. Bring back anything. Bring back the tankards."
"Some of what lies in {site} belongs to families in Saltmere. Bring it up, and we'll see it home."
"A box floated up out of {site} last spring with coin in it. There'll be more. We can't swim that far."
"I'll carry anything you bring out of {site}, for a share. Mind the boxes that knock back."

fens.label: Chests opened in {site}
fens.journal: Go into {site} and open {n} of its chests.
fens.ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Drowned Eel in Saltmere.
fens.done: Whatever was in them is Saltmere's now, which is to say Pim's.
